consent.title: Playtest data
consent.what_brief: To help the playtest team, the game can record gameplay events, timings and the categories of your choices (never text). Audio, recordings, messages, anything you type, names and IPs are never collected.
consent.question: May playtest data be recorded?
consent.opt.no_sub: Record nothing. The game works the same.
consent.opt.local_sub: Local playtest logs stay on this computer; you can export and send them yourself.
consent.opt.cloud_sub: The same anonymous logs are also sent to the playtest team.
consent.later: You can change or withdraw this any time in Settings > Privacy.
privacy.title: Playtest data
privacy.what: To help the playtest team the game can record gameplay events (task results, votes, timings) and the categories of your choices. Records use a random anonymous id; it does not identify you.
privacy.never: Audio, recordings, transcripts, messages and any text you type; player names; IP addresses.
privacy.recording_note: Consent for call recordings is separate: it is the lobby's 'Calls may be recorded' switch (the host's). This tab only manages playtest data.
privacy.host_note: Data you already gave a host or facilitator has to be deleted by them; the buttons here only delete what is on this computer.
privacy.unavailable: This build has no playtest data collection.
privacy.state.unknown: Right now: not chosen yet (recording is off).
privacy.state.local: Right now: on this computer only.
privacy.state.cloud: Right now: on this computer + cloud.
privacy.withdraw_note: After withdrawing nothing new is recorded. To remove old records use the button below.
privacy.delete_confirm: Delete every playtest log and queue on this computer?
privacy.delete_failed: Some files could not be deleted.
privacy.reset_id_confirm: Create a new random id? Old records will not be linked to the new one.
privacy.export_failed: The archive could not be created.
privacy.export_note: You decide who gets the exported file.
intro.0.title: The company target is everyone's
intro.0.text: Everyone works toward the same productivity target. Miss it and the company closes: everybody is fired.
intro.1.title: Your secret objective, private calls
intro.1.text: Everyone has a secret objective. Talk privately by phone or text, bargain, bluff: but every sabotage leaves a record.
intro.2.title: Meeting, evidence, final vote
intro.2.text: Meetings weigh complaints and records; you present the evidence. In the final vote someone is fired only by majority, and 'Fire nobody' is an option.
moment.title: Mark this moment
moment.note: Only leaves a bookmark for the playtest team. Nobody else in the game sees it; no text is saved.
moment.limit: You reached the limit of {1} marks for this match
